research_scope: Source-free mathematical prerequisite identity audit against original formulation text; parent scope and stronger structural conditions remain distinct.

aliases.reason: The convex-hull intersection formulation computes ⋂ over all convex supersets of U and the topological-closure intersection formulation computes ⋂ over all topologically closed supersets of A. Both invoke arbitrary intersection of a family of subsets; convexity and topological closedness define different indexing predicates retained in their parents.

The full outer measure source codomain and the nonnegative measure source codomain are exactly the extended nonnegative reals [0,+∞], with usual ordering and extended sums. The outer-measure domain P(X) and countable subadditivity differ from measure domain Σ and countable additivity; only the codomain prerequisite is shared.

The finite locally free module and locally free module definitions both require a cover Spec(R)=⋃_i D(f_i) by distinguished principal opens D(f_i). The additional finite-rank restriction on localized modules is parent-level and is not promoted into the general definition of a standard-open cover.

The projective flat Mittag-Leffler criterion uses a direct sum ⊕_i M_i of countably generated modules; the colimit construction uses a direct sum of general R-modules. The shared prerequisite is finite-support direct sum. Countable generation of each summand and global projectivity criteria remain distinct conditions in the parent statement.

The category-hom-set source identifies Hom_C(x,y) for fixed endpoints and explicitly has a small-category size convention; the general preadditive/representable-presheaf source identifies the Hom-collection with the same typing. Smallness grants the set property locally, while the shared prerequisite is precisely the collection of morphisms with fixed endpoints.
